Orange Logic is the agentic orchestration layer for your content ecosystem. At its core is an Agentic DAM: a system where content, context, and intelligence come together and AI operates across your workflows, tools, and teams. With Orange Logic, you can design, deploy, and orchestrate

AI agents that:

- Understand your content, rights, and governance

- Coordinate tasks across systems and teams

- Continuously optimize how content is created, managed, and delivered

## HOW ORANGE LOGIC EVOLVES

Most DAM systems force every team into the same structure. Over time, that one size-fits-all fits no one. This slows adoption and creates workarounds.

Orange Logic allows each team to adapt their environment and workflows independently without affecting the other teams.

**Marketing. Legal. Video. Product.**

Different workflows. Different user experiences. One system.
